name: Search and Rescue
description: Investigate reports of something falling from the sky in Gurhacia Valley.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: Miners in the valley just reported something falling from the sky.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: The wildlife out there is dangerous. Try not to get hurt too bad, rookie.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: The gates are a security measure.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: We do what we can to try and prevent hostiles from overrunning everything.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: Boxes are provisions other folks have brought out here.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: Most of the time they're abandoned, so you're free to take what you find.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: If your HP gets low, don't be stubborn about it. Use a healing item before you need one, not after.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: If something hits hard, back off and figure out its pattern before you commit.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: Focus on one enemy at a time. Take down the smaller ones first if they're in the way.

dialog.speaker: Kai
dialog.text: You can report back to the guild, I'll take her back to the city.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: Kai, thank you for joining this mission. We got reports from miners that something fell from the sky.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Kai
briefing_dialog.text: Probably just another meteor right? Can't i sit this one out?

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: It seems like it could be something bigger, that's why we're sending you to investigate.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Kai
briefing_dialog.text: Fine, so what's with the runt?

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: This one just signed up, i was hoping you could show him the ropes.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Kai
briefing_dialog.text: Great, errands and now baby sitting. Why am i stuck with this kid?

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: We're short on man power, if the kid slows you down you can leave him behind.
